children: Sweden medical imaging IT firm's Q1 net sales rose 25.8% yr/yr
Recurring revenue up 31.7%, cloud recurring revenue tops SEK 1 bln on 12-month basis
Contracted order bookings fell 46.6% yr/yr, company cites prior strong bookings and investments
Sectra says continued investments may impact costs and profitability in individual periods
Company sees long-term opportunities from strong order book and market position
CLOUD SERVICES GROWTH - Co said recurring revenue from cloud services exceeded SEK 1 bln, driven by strong prior order bookings and investments in scaling up offerings
EXPANDING CUSTOMER BASE - CEO said more customers using Sectra's solutions strengthened recurring revenue base and profitability
CONTINUED INVESTMENTS - CEO said ongoing investments in people, technology, security and delivery capacity are needed to meet customer needs and support long-term opportunities
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 2 "strong buy" or "buy", 1 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the advanced medical equipment & technology peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Sectra AB is SEK340.00, about 16.9% above its September 3 closing price of SEK290.80
The stock recently traded at 71 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 78 three months ago
